newsitem.title: USA: St. Mary Land files for two mln common.
newsitem.headline: St. Mary Land files for two mln common.

text.p: St. Mary Land & Exploration Co said Tuesday it filed a registration with the Securities and Exchange Commission to sell up to two million common shares.

The company has offered the underwriters a 30-day over-allotment option to purchase up to 300,000 additional common shares. The offering will be made through Morgan Keegan & Co Inc., A.G. Edwards & Sons Inc and Hanifen, Imhoff Inc.
After the offering, outstanding shares will total 10,759,214 common, the filing said.

Net proceeds, together with internally generated cash flows and borrowings under the company's credit facility with a commercial bank, will be used to fund exploration and developement activities and potential acquisitions.
Proceeds will also be used for general corporate purposes, the company said in the filing.
St. Mary Land, based in Denver, Colo., is an independent energy company engaged in the exploration, development, acquisition and production of crude oil and natural gas.
